note: Row is chosen by the RAW SUM of the two attributes, then shifted by row offsets (clamped to the table).

derived.name: Squares per Round
derived.desc: Tactical movement grid distance per round
derived.use: How many grid squares one Move action covers (1 square = 1.5 m). Prone halves it; difficult terrain costs double.

derived.name: Meters per Minute
derived.use: Travel speed outside combat — chases, patrols, getting across a district.

derived.name: Offensive Bonus
derived.desc: Base modifier applied to attack rolls
derived.use: Added to the damage of every weapon hit you land, and to opportunity attacks (1d4 + OFF).

derived.name: Actions per Round
derived.desc: Total tactical action points per turn
derived.use: How many actions you get each combat round. Stunned leaves you with 1. Dodging spends actions from the next round.

derived.name: Defensive Bonus
derived.use: Your defensive edge against incoming attacks. How it applies to enemy attack rolls is still an open rule — the GM decides for now.

derived.name: Perception Bonus
derived.desc: Modifier for detecting traps and stealth
derived.use: Your knack for noticing traps, ambushes and hidden details. The GM uses it when something could be spotted.

initiative.use: Rolled once when combat starts: d20 + this. Highest total acts first and the order stays fixed for the whole fight.
